[b]Random historical documents of Chimú history[/b]
[b]~1370, Châuwtin[/b].
[b]Ceramic inscriptions[/b]
[i]The corn harvest has been worsening every year, the soil is arid and rains are scarce, the sacerdots say it is a test sent by Sheuco[god of climate], some however, believe the sapa is losing his divine mandate, the recent shakes of Camác, droughts, floods of Wichar, Mayao and famine seems to prove it [/i]
Author: Unknown.
[b]Chimoy expedition chronic fragment[/b]
[b]1122-1125, Chanchán, written by several sailors, potentially Chimoy himself some parts.[/b]
[i][...]From the Imperial capital i departed, we had about 30 Cochawapôs[chimor ships], for the journey were brought 200 Cól of Vicugna cloth, Tàmraks of food in will  keep us alive for many cycles.
[...]After 1 cycle on sea, we contacted the Sangál, a place known as "Wáral", their kuraka Chápi Rakàla gifted us with 20 Kós[slaves], they were young, one of them was named a man named Chikita, who the Awi[prince, Chimoy] developed a great relation with, and asked to not talk or record about.

 [/i]

(1500 Words)

[b]Special Military Operation in Southern Amarillo - "Rolling along smoothly"[/b]

[pre]Gendarmite National Broadcasting Network | The Daily Bird | Tumultoria International[/pre]

[i]12 days into the Gendarmite endorsed 'Special Military Operation' in Southern Amarallo and officials report that the Rajyami Colonial Security Force(RCSF) and the Rajyami Defense Forces(RDF) have successfully captured the Ravana region with the Gendarmite - Rajyami flag being flewn over Carmello Tower in Kailashpur, Ravana. Seasoned Admiral Étienne Leclerc who is known for his gallant defense of the Capricorn archipelago from Imperial Bravanor is rumored to now be dispatched to the Raj to aid in its preparation for further engagement with New Arenenge after the truce ceases. The current casualties from the special military operation is currently unknown but the Daily Bird, a Gendarmite private news outlet claims casualties range from one hundred - three hundred fifty dead, injured, or missing.[/I]

[spoiler=[u][b]April  1st, 2025
Terrox, Gendarmite Raj[/b][/u]]

[I]The bustling port city of Terrox was one of the only few guaranteed ports that were out of range of the attacking Arenett forces and Communist insurgents, this made it the virtual lifeline between the Raj and mainland Gendarme which allowed for the Commonwealth to continue fueling the Rajyami war machine. The Gendarmites had sent Admiral Étienne Leclerc on a mission to provide unconditional support for the military campaign in southern Amarillo and ensure that the operation was executed smoothly while guaranteeing the safety of the Maharaja. Prime Minister Grégoire Tremble had scrambled what forces the Commonwealth had left to focus its ambitions on knocking out Arenenge and expanding the Raj, and Leclerc would be his last hope...

The Maharaja's royal palace was conspicous to all other infrastructure within the city, its pearl embedded walls and golden plated shrines made it one of the most luxurious residencies in the Commonwealth. Outside of the palace a black armored limousine swerved into the gravel driveway of the mansion, followed by 4 armored trucks that ensured its security. Inside the limousine sat Admiral Étienne Leclerc, light glinting off his uniform, which was adorned with a host of medals, each one telling a story of the sacrifice and hardship he had went through in Bravanor. His stern face left an almost chilling effect on all those near him, as he gazed upon the golden labrynth of the palace. "[b]Are you ready to go sir?[/b]" The driver asked Leclerc, his hands gripping the steering wheel tightly, a clear sign of his nervousness in the presence of the seasoned Admiral. But the Admiral was not a man who sought to instill fear in those below him. Beneath his solemn demeanor, he was a caring man, one who showed more sympathy than most, one who learned fear before bravery. "[b]My apologies, sure - I'll be heading out now.[/b]" Leclerc clutched the ornate door handle and packed his stuff before opening the door. Leclerc was immediately met by a platoon of heavily armed men who huddled their burly bodies around Admiral like a human meat shield, completely concealing his body from public eye. The men escorted Leclerc into the palace while continuously looking around the city for potential threats. 

Once Leclerc finally entered the palace, the nuisance of the bombardment ceased. He turned his gaze toward the towering silver pillars that supported the palace's frame. Each one must have cost millions, he thought. A multitude of women dressed in gold jewlery and elegant gowns immediately greeted Leclerc, each being one of the Maharaja's many wives. But one person caught Leclerc's attention. At the edge of his sight, a short dark-skinned man covered in gold and silver stood out. His attire gleamed under the bright lighting of the palace, his eyes glowed a fierce yellow intensity that gave Leclerc goosebumps. "[b]You must be the Maharaja, I am Admiral Étienne Leclerc - guardian of Alicia, saviour of Capricorn.[/b]" Leclerc asked, the man nodded his head, each movement caused the jewelry on his turban to collide and make a harsh clanging sound. "[b]Indeed, I believe you are the man who succesfully defended the Gendarme's other colonial possessions far west? My advisors have come to me telling stories about your undying courage as you successfully knocked out the Bravanorian Imperialists outnumbered and encircled.[/b]" Leclerc nodded his head in response to the Maharaja's questions. "[b]Follow me, we must waste no time. Your immediate aid in the Ravana offensive is crucial.[/b]" Leclerc followed the little men as he led him through multiple rooms emphasizing the undeniable size of the palace, finally - the men had reached their destination. The Royal Quarters, a room highlighted by its plastered Maplewood finish and glowing quartz glass.  

"[b]This is where well be working for the next year or two. The room is equipped with special defenses and protocols, armed to the teeth to keep us safe, should anything go wrong - God forbid..[/b]" The anxiety in the face of the Maharaja was as clear as day, the fear of potential failure had caved itself into the back of his mind, and it wasn't leaving until they were certain the Gendarmites would win. Leclerc looked around the room before focusing his gaze on a map at the center of the Maplewood table, the map had multiple plywood pieces each representing a certain military force. With his robust intuition he was able to immideatley spot out that the Y-shaped pieces represented attacks while the X represented defenses across the Rajyami - Arenett strait. "[b]So what is your current plan? You can't win a war if you don't know what you're doing...[/b]" The Admiral asked, now focusing his attention on the frantic-faced Maharaja. The Maharaja opened a chair before pointing to another chair signaling for Leclerc to sit, he soon ran his finger across the map, picking one of the Y-shaped pieces before responding. "[b]We plan on using our invasion of Ravana as a gateway to breaking past the warzone that is the Rajyami - Arenett strait. The Rajyami Armed Forces, also known as the RAF will be spearheading the assault with a mechanized division of specialized anti-troop and expeditioneers. Following them would be the combined forces of motorized and airborne assualt which would focus on locking down and capturing strategic centers such as towns, bridges, and supply hubs to continue the campaign.[/b]" Leclerc nodded his head, the Maharaja's plan was a formidable one, but it still had flaws that could be exposed he thought to himself. Leclerc grabbed one of the Y-shaped pieces and began placing them in a western formation across the Kramol river. The Maharaja was shocked, yet couldn't understand what Leclerc was even doing. "[b]Your Highness, while your plan is strong and capable of mounting a formidable offensive, it overlooks one key factor. If the enemy counterattacks, the strategy could falter. This is why we must also prepare a solid defensive fallback in case things dont go as planned. I recommend we set up the Gendarmite Colonial Security Force or GCSF as a defensive line, fortifying the Raj from its southern flank. This would provide crucial protection, ensuring that even if the offensive fails, the Raj remains secure and we can regroup without losing ground. I believe they will be more familiar with defending the Raj than preforming an actual expedition, but this is only my opinion.[/b]" The Maharaja's face shifted from shocked to awe, the Admiral's intellect and experience surprised him. "[b]I will think about your proposition, for it is very appealing. But now we must cease this meeting, I have a speech to attend by 1630 and I'm going to be late if I stay for another hour. It's a pleasure working with you Leclerc, I'll see you here tommorow at 0830.[/b]" He said, Leclerc nodded his head and began packing his bags as both men departed the room to continue other errands.[/I][/spoiler]

[spoiler=MARKING TIME, WAITING FOR DEATH]

[b]RAVANA[/b]

[pre]16 hours after Rajyami and Gendarmite forces crossed into international territory, a violent confrontation between the People's Liberation Army of Maha-Vajra(PLAMV) and the Gendarmite Colonial Security Force(GCSF) and Rajyami Armed Forces(RAF) began in the remote village of Vajrakot 15KM south of Kailashpur. The fighting led to the destruction of the Syranath bridge which is the only traversable gateway between Ravana and the rest of Maha-Vajra on ground. This has virtually led to all PLAMV forces fighting within Ravana to be trapped and outnumbered. After 2 hours of intense fighting GCSF forces aided by RAF artillery and aerial support were able to effectively neutralize all PLAMV forces within the village, securing it for further logistical transportation. The Gendarmite Colonial flag would be raised upon the Jorge Bread Factory in the center of the village. This decisive victory would open the rest of Ravana to further Gendarmite expansion but it would also be limited by the destruction of the Syranath bridge which the Rajyamis hoped to retain ownership of.
[/pre][/spoiler]
